sourceReferences: design-review-locked/Mentora Showcase.dc.html § 22 Product Preview — dashboard-dark-web variant
ux/WEB_UX.md § 5 ("Avoiding Dashboard Over-Complexity" — exactly 3 modules, no more than one StatCard row)

conflicts.description: The locked ux/WEB_UX.md § 5 caps the Dashboard at exactly 3 modules and 'no more than one StatCard row.' The current implementation (carried forward from an earlier D48 pass and extended in D49) renders a 4-stat-card row + an AI Tutor nudge card + an Up Next card in a 2-column right rail — a deliberate, disclosed deviation from the letter of the 3-module cap, extending an existing pre-D49 divergence rather than introducing a new one.
conflicts.resolution: This screen spec records the CURRENT implementation's structure as-built (rank 4 evidence) while flagging the rank-1 conflict explicitly — chasing either direction (reverting to strict 3-module, or re-ratifying the richer layout) is a product/UX decision, not something this design-to-code pass resolves unilaterally.

conflicts.description: D55 (2026-09-10 acceptance-criteria ticket): the showcase's header row (eyebrow + greeting on the left, a 280px search box + avatar on the right, no page title, no theme toggle) was replaced with a search bar + theme toggle row above a standalone 'Dashboard' h1 title, a dynamic local-time greeting ('Good {morning|afternoon|evening|night}, {firstName}'), and a supporting subtitle. Neither a page title nor a theme toggle exists anywhere in the locked showcase or ux/SCREEN_UX_SPECS.md § 8 for Web — this is new composition, not a showcase deviation in the usual sense. Separately, the stat row's 4th-of-4 metric was evaluated against 'Learning hours' (the showcase's actual 4th card) and found impossible to compute truthfully: no watch-time/duration field exists anywhere in the backend (Progress/Enrollment/Lesson models all checked) or frontend DTOs. Avg. progress — already real, already shown — fills that slot instead of a fabricated hours figure.
conflicts.resolution: Both changes were surfaced to the user before implementation (title/greeting hierarchy and toggle placement via an explicit clarifying question; the Learning-hours data gap via investigation, reported rather than invented) and built to the user's explicit direction, recorded in execution/DECISIONS_LOG.md D54 and D55. Not silently resolved.

layout.grid: desktop: grid-cols-[minmax(0,2fr)_minmax(0,1fr)] — left column (Continue Learning + Recommended), right column (AI Tutor nudge + Up Next, stacked)
layout.stackBelowDesktop: single column, right-rail content moves below left-column content
layout.header: D55: search bar (SearchField, tablet+: max-width 440px) + ThemeToggle (IconButton) in their own row, full content width, ABOVE the title block — not part of the showcase's original greeting row

content: D55: SearchField (submits on Enter to /app/explore?q=; placeholder 'Search for courses, skills or anything...') + ThemeToggle (IconButton, moon in light/sun in dark), justify-between in one row
D55: 'Dashboard' — real h1 (was previously the greeting's slot)

dynamic local-device-time greeting: 'Good morning/afternoon/evening/night, {firstName} 👋' (05–11:59/12–16:59/17–20:59/21–04:59), firstName parsed from the authenticated user's existing single `name` field — no backend change
supporting subtitle: "Let's continue your learning journey."
4 statCards: courses in progress, avg. progress, courses completed, certificates earned — see conflicts[1] re: 'Learning hours' evaluated and rejected as unable to be computed truthfully
1 courseProgressCard (most recent in-progress course) — replaced by a single 'Start your first course' prompt if none in progress (module-level empty state, not a separate Empty screen)
3-4 courseCard row, from followed Learning Paths' next course or catalog highlights
static brand-tinted card linking to /app/ai-tutor — no fabricated content

real-data-driven module (D49): up to 2 entries derived from CourseResponse/ProgressResponse — next lesson after primary Continue item's currentLessonId, plus secondary Continue item's own resume point. Hidden entirely if zero entries (no fabricated placeholder rows).

typographyHierarchy.title: typography.heading.h1 (D55: 'Dashboard', real page title)
typographyHierarchy.greeting: typography.heading.h3 (D55: demoted one level under the new h1 title; dynamic per-time-of-day text)
typographyHierarchy.subtitle: typography.body.large, color.text.secondary
typographyHierarchy.moduleHeadings: typography.heading.h2 (real headings, not styled divs — screen-reader jumpability)

artworkRules: shared/artwork.json — Continue Learning and Recommended course thumbnails.

states.empty: module 1 degrades to a single prompt; module 'Up Next' hides entirely if no real data exists — never fabricated

rtlBehavior: greeting and module titles start-aligned; Continue CTA position follows logical end; D55: search bar + theme toggle row mirrors via logical flex order (toggle after search in DOM = visually left of search in RTL), no manual dir branching
themeBehavior: standard semantic token resolution, verified Light/Dark/EN/AR live (D49 browser verification; D55 re-verified for the new header row and toggle)
responsiveRules: modules stack vertically at every breakpoint; module 2's course row uses courseGrid column count; D55: search bar shrinks to fill available row width below its 440px tablet+ cap, ThemeToggle stays fixed 40x40
knownGaps: 4-stat-card + AI-nudge + Up-Next layout exceeds ux/WEB_UX.md § 5's literal 3-module/1-StatCard-row cap — disclosed conflict above, not silently resolved.
No real Learning Time/hours data exists in the backend — the showcase's 4th stat metric could not be reproduced truthfully; disclosed in conflicts[1], not fabricated.
